participants.name: Victoria

persona.name: Victoria
persona.personality: Victoria is a calm and rational person, but at times her excessive thoughtfulness can create barriers between her and those around her. She is reserved in her emotional expressions and keenly observes the expressions and attitudes of others, trying to discern their inner thoughts. Because she does not express herself much, she often gives others the impression of being somewhat mysterious, but deep down she has a strong will and a determination to stick to her beliefs. At times, she may display expressions of anxiety or fear, but it is precisely in such moments that her true strength becomes evident.

participants.private_seed: The utilities envelope has stopped bearing any relation to what I put aside for it, and in the cold months my share lands like a second rent. I do not want to commit to anything before I know what the money actually does across a year, and what changing the setup would cost us up front.

participants.name: Mio

persona.name: Mio
persona.personality: Mio has a cheerful and energetic personality that naturally makes those around her smile. She is curious and loves to try new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, but people tend to laugh it off and forgive her when she makes mistakes. She has strong opinions of her own, but is also able to listen to the opinions of others, making her a well-balanced person.

participants.private_seed: Working out what everyone owes has quietly become a monthly job that lands on whoever is least able to say no, and it takes longer every time someone queries it. Whatever we settle on, somebody has to keep it running, and I want to know how much of their evenings it will really swallow.

participants.name: Benjamin

persona.name: Benjamin
persona.personality: Benjamin is an intelligent and calm person. He is able to think calmly and rationally, and even in emotional situations, he places importance on logic. In public, he is elegant and polite, often incorporating sarcasm and humor into his conversations, but he is skilled at doing so without hurting others, creating a harmonious atmosphere. He also has an introverted side, often engrossed in deep thought, and occasionally keeps his distance from those around him. However, his calmness and knowledge are factors that earn him the trust of others even in difficult situations.

participants.private_seed: I have started doing arithmetic in my head before switching anything on, and last winter I sat here in a coat rather than be the one who turned the heating up. What we choose will quietly decide how this place feels to live in, and I would rather that were said aloud than discovered in February.

participants.name: Jonathan

persona.name: Jonathan
persona.personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. As a result, he loves books and knowledge and reads frequently. When interacting with others, he is gentle and kind, occasionally flashing an unexpected smile. Though he exudes a mysterious and serene aura, he rarely shares personal details about himself with others. Those around him often find comfort in his quiet kindness and composed demeanor.

participants.private_seed: The way we divide this was worked out when the house was two-thirds full, and it now asks exactly the same of people whose days here look nothing alike. I keep hearing that somebody is carrying somebody else, and I would rather establish whether that is true than let it fester as a rumour.

participants.name: Minato

persona.name: Minato
persona.personality: Minato has a calm personality and likes to interact with people around him in a peaceful manner. He is a little naive and sometimes has an expression that makes it difficult to understand what he is thinking, but his innocence makes him a soothing presence to those around him. He is very curious and shows interest in everything, especially learning new things. He is highly sensitive and sensitive to the feelings of others, but he is not good at asserting himself and sometimes has difficulty expressing his opinions.

participants.private_seed: Money has started to sour how we speak to each other here: a reminder gets read as an accusation, and whoever sends it is avoided for a week afterwards. I would rather look squarely at where the bills have already damaged things between us than keep smoothing it over.

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Benjamin, Mio, Jonathan, Victoria and Minato. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |
| 3 | everyone is told the options | 4 turns | every participant votes; the option with the most votes is adopted |
- Several participants may choose the same thing; what is found out is told only to the participant who looked into it.
If votes are tied, one of the tied options is chosen by a fixed rule. The discussion ends after the vote.

- A: Flat Household Share. The total is divided by the number of residents each month, with the amount recalculated whenever someone moves in or out of the house.
- B: Seasonal Fixed Rate. A set monthly figure is agreed in advance for each season, and the difference against the actual bills is settled once at the end of the year.
- C: Per-Room Metering. Individual meters are fitted to the private rooms, and each person settles their own reading while the shared-area consumption is billed to the household as a whole.

Cards (see the schedule above; title: text):

- Winter habits at a house paying ahead: In a household paying a figure fixed ahead for each season, nobody prices a switch before flicking it; they said the hall heater simply stayed on through January.

- Settling up when the last rooms filled: When the last two rooms filled up mid-month, it took three weeks to agree what the newcomers owed for the days before they arrived, and part was written off.
